question: Should Neuralwatt’s active subscription kWh allowance be displayed as a second quota, or is prepaid-credit-only display an intentional product contract?
rationale: The API exposes two independently usable pools, and automated review cannot decide whether CodexBar may intentionally present only one when that can imply exhaustion incorrectly.

options.title: Surface both quota pools
options.body: Show subscription kWh alongside prepaid credits so the menu reflects actual remaining Neuralwatt availability.

options.title: Accept prepaid-only semantics
options.body: Keep the smaller UI but explicitly label it as prepaid credit rather than total availability and add subscription-focused behavior tests.

options.title: Pause the provider
options.body: Hold the integration until the intended multi-unit quota presentation is designed.

recommendation.title: Surface both quota pools
recommendation.body: Show subscription kWh alongside prepaid credits so the menu reflects actual remaining Neuralwatt availability.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the branch hardening and recorded the unresolved product-contract recommendation on the earlier implementation.
